title: Language Model Harnesses can be Compositional Generalizers
title_zh: 语言模型运行框架可以实现组合泛化
abstract_en: Modern language models (LMs) are post-trained and deployed as agents inside a "harness", but standard harness designs accumulate context that the neural network is forced to generalize to, making training for long-horizon tasks expensive and time-consuming. We study an alternative emerging path: training inherently neurosymbolic LM harnesses, which externalize and manage context programmatically to compose existing LM capabilities. We hypothesize that training around these harnesses can offer a better return on compute by enabling compositional generalization, as they can learn to decompose complex problems so that every observation their neural LM receives is locally in-distribution, even when the full task is novel. We find that harnesses like the Recursive Language Model (RLM) learn such decompositions readily under reinforcement learning post-training: (1) we demonstrate that training only on short tasks can generalize to tasks 2-64$\times$ longer while the base neural LM improves less, and (2) training on one domain transfers to novel domains that share latent structure. On messier, complex tasks, we find that we can target individual LLM calls within a harness by generating and training on easier, synthetically generated surrogate environments with fake tool / sub-calls, a technique we call surrogate harness training. From this finding, we train RLM-27B on synthetic data, and show it improves Qwen3.8-27B in the same RLM harness on a hard suite of long-context tasks like CTC-Bench and ExpertLongBench by 26.9% on average while using $\sim$2$\times$ fewer tokens at inference time. Finally, we show that harnesses can compose over these newly learned decompositions using recursive sub-harness calls.
abstract_zh: 现代语言模型（LM）通常在运行框架（harness）中接受后训练，并作为智能体部署。传统框架不断累积上下文，要求模型直接适应越来越长的输入，使长程任务训练耗时且昂贵。本文研究一种神经符号框架：用程序将上下文移出模型输入并加以管理，再组合模型已有的能力。其核心思路是把复杂任务拆解为多个局部子任务，使整体任务即便是新的，每次调用看到的输入仍落在模型熟悉的分布内。实验表明，Recursive Language Model（RLM）经过强化学习后训练后，仅在短任务上训练即可泛化到长度为训练任务 2–64 倍的任务，且提升大于基础 LM；在一个领域学到的分解策略也能迁移到潜在结构相同的新领域。对于更复杂的任务，作者提出替代框架训练（surrogate harness training），通过合成更简单的环境并模拟工具调用和子调用，针对框架内的单次模型调用开展训练。在相同的 RLM 框架下，仅用合成数据训练的 RLM-27B 在包含 CTC-Bench 和 ExpertLongBench 的长上下文任务套件上较 Qwen3.8-27B 平均提升 26.9%，推理 token 用量约为后者的一半。框架还可以通过递归调用子框架，进一步组合已学到的分解策略。
key_points_zh: RLM 以程序管理外部上下文，让模型分次处理局部子任务，而非直接面对不断累积的完整上下文。
强化学习后训练使 RLM 从短任务泛化到 2–64 倍长的任务，并迁移到潜在结构相同的新领域。
替代框架训练用带有模拟工具调用和子调用的简单合成环境，训练复杂流程中的单次模型调用。
同一框架下，RLM-27B 在长上下文任务套件上较 Qwen3.8-27B 平均提升 26.9%，推理 token 用量约减半。
递归调用子框架可以把已学到的任务分解策略进一步组合起来。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 核心贡献是用带模拟工具和子调用的代理环境训练通用文本智能体，使其策略学会在可复用框架中分解任务。同框架对照量化了性能和推理开销；递归子调用用于任务分解，并未证明改进机制本身会自我改进。
